canonical.assignment: assignment.type is target declared slot; flowType is original checked RHS result, store conversion never changes expression result
canonical.compatibilityRoots: expression.compatibilityRoots is optional; if present it is a nonempty dense array of existing {sourceType,targetType} dependency objects in strict UTF8 sourceType/targetType order, unique. Each pair inherits this expression original source path and UTF16 range as classAnchor and joins the exact same-origin directory M12 record. Ordinary relations require every source variant to select a representation-preserving target; as validates operand flowType to result flowType, then contextual relations validate result flowType to expected. Every explicit root must be actually selected and consumed by those relations at this node; as and contextual roots share one sorted unique array. Parentheses inner and outer nodes retain their own original occurrence roots. Pure identity union/presence widening or selection of existing target nonpresence IDs changes no payload or representation and needs no member proof. RuntimeKey is never assignability. The former expression.compatibility field is removed.
canonical.compatibilityWitnesses: required payload.compatibilityWitnesses contains {compatibility: unchanged M12 classCompatibility, dependencies:[{sourceType,targetType}]}. Identity is (compatibility.origin.source,start,end,sourceType,targetType); directory strictly sorted by origin.source UTF8, start numeric, end numeric, sourceType UTF8, targetType UTF8, unique. Dependencies inherit current origin, strictly UTF8 sourceType/targetType pair sorted and unique; active pair cycles use pair back-references. Every expression.compatibilityRoots pair is a root with an exact matching directory record; publish only successful selected roots and their reachable closure. Every dependency resolves within the same origin and is a selected nested field/method logical reference relation; every dependency must be consumed and every record root-reachable. Identity logical relations require no extra proof. No inferred member names or new hash IDs.
canonical.construction: Nominal construction is required and uses one concrete logical type catalog throughout generic signature and shared M12 classParameter/classSignature/classImplicitForward/classCompatibility records. construction.id is owner type.id plus .ctor. kind is explicit iff constructor is an actual Function, otherwise implicit-base without base or implicit-derived with base; no fake Source functions or parameter declarations. origin is actual constructor declaration for explicit, actual class declaration for implicit. access is actual public/protected/private visibility, or effective inherited visibility. signature uses the actual selected construct signature, whose returnType is owner nominal id and whose parameter types equal construction.parameters[].type. Signature id/sourcePath/declarationRange preserve the official declaration (possibly ancestor constructor); only an official declaration-less default signature uses its actual owner class declaration as provenance. Explicit parameters[].symbol match constructor.parameters[].id and retain actual ParameterDeclaration origins; inheritedFrom is empty. Implicit-derived parameters use construction.id plus .p plus zero-based decimal ordinal, retain the actual inherited ParameterDeclaration origin and inheritedFrom the direct-base construction parameter symbol; these are logical bindings, never invented AST.
canonical.constructorForward: implicitForward is required nullable: nonnull only for implicit-derived. It reuses unchanged M12 classImplicitForward fields target/baseSignature/parameters/origin. target is direct-base construction.id, baseSignature preserves its shared M12 parameters and return (same catalog ids), origin is this actual class declaration. Each ordinal source/target maps the owned implicit logical symbol to the actual direct-base parameter symbol with unchanged M12 classCompatibility from the official checker. Source/target logical type identities agree; actual original parameter declarations and inheritedFrom relations are retained. Managed nominal members and owned Array/ReadSpan length members use their existing source ids; no inferred names, fake members, numeric conversion or extra expression roots. All forwarding parameters and mappings are complete and ordered.
canonical.constructorInitialization: initializationPhase is before-body without a base and after-successful-super with a base. Under the pinned actual native ESNext field options, initializationFields orders each ordinary own property in original declaration order first, then each parameter-property binding assignment in actual constructor parameter order; each own field id appears exactly once and inherited fields never reinitialize. This is evaluation/assignment order, independent of layout/catalog order and implicit native property definitions. Native parameter-property declarations have no initializer expression; their parameter values are assigned by the TypeScript runtime syntax transform in the constructor body, after native ordinary field initialization. Existing parameterBinding joins only real parameter-properties and existing initializer expressions retain original lexical scopes. No initializer expression or value is invented for fields lacking one. superConstruct stays at its actual body occurrence and original ordered arguments; successful direct-base construction precedes native derived own field initialization, then derived parameter-property assignments, before subsequent body evaluation. The Source imposes no unconditional exactly-one-super or first-statement rule: actual official diagnostics and preserved control flow decide source validity. Bare constructor return is preserved; expression returns remain subject to the original official strict diagnostics, with no fabricated owner-valued expression.
canonical.field: field id sha256: + SHA256(tsfg.array-facts.field.v8\0 + JCS({sourcePath,nameRange})); optional parameterBinding joins only original constructor parameter-properties, ordinary fields never acquire it
canonical.files: strict UTF8 path order, exact SHA256 bytes, complete consumed original source closure

canonical.method: function.ownerType joins concrete nominal catalog; type.methods lists owned function ids; call.receiver evaluated before arguments; overrideTarget joins original actual base method
canonical.nominal: nominal: plus SHA256 hex of tsfg.array-facts.nominal.v8\0 + JCS(shared nominalKey)
canonical.ownedCompilerOptions: Exact request config remains strict:true,noEmit:true,allowJs:false; target/useDefineForClassFields are not caller options in this candidate. The original newOwnedProgram fixes NoLib:true,NoEmit:true,Strict:true,Target:ScriptTargetESNext with UseDefineForClassFields unspecified, whose official computed value is true and GetEmitStandardClassFields is true. The producer verifies these actual effective field options. Native ESNext field semantics, not a downlevel classfields transformer branch, govern construction ordering. A change to the fixed owned options requires coordinated contract/projection/consumer revalidation; payload retains the original request config unchanged.
canonical.request: sha256: + SHA256(tsfg.array-facts.request.v8\0 + request bytes including LF)
canonical.scalar: logical pinned scalar declaration name; no arbitrary number alias reinterpretation
canonical.string: primitive checker string; M24 lossless codeUnits int32 0..65535, no Unicode normalization, references retain String value identity
canonical.superConstruct: superConstruct is only an actual super(...) CallExpression inside its explicit constructor function, with callee the actual directBase nominal id and calleeRange the original super token. expression type/flowType are official void; signature is the actual selected direct-base construct signature returning the Base nominal instance. Arguments retain original left-to-right order and actual contextual parameter types/witness roots. The callee joins its construction metadata and explicit real Function or implicit forwarding facts.
canonical.this: thisReference type is constructor/method ownerType or class-field initializer owner catalog; no invented parameter
canonical.types: strict UTF8 id order; every type reference resolves
canonical.union: flattened unique constituents in strict UTF8 id order; >=2; union<comma-joined ids>; checker-proven members, flow independently projected
